spans.s:
नैधन नैधन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. नि-धन),
subject to death, liable to decay, perishable, relating
to death, causing death; (in astrology with or with-
out गृह) the eighth house, the house of death.

नैधान नैधान, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to a
treasure, to a nest, &c.; (ई), f. a boundary where
articles of value are buried and dug up (?).

नैध्रुवि नैध्रुवि, इस्, m. (patronymic fr.
नि-ध्रुव), an epithet of Kāśyapa.
